question: What is the meaning of installers in relation to delivery and construction?
description: Installers are responsible for the final assembly and integration of building components and systems, ensuring that all elements function properly and meet the required standards. They play a crucial role in the construction process, as they are the last link in the delivery chain before the structure is handed over to the owner or user. Installers work closely with contractors, designers, and other stakeholders to ensure a smooth handover and to address any issues that may arise during the installation phase. Their work is essential for the successful completion of a construction project.
